basic.name: Chain Heal
basic.description: Heal an ally with a wave of healing for 260~~0.04~~ Health. The wave then bounces 2 times to nearby allies within 7 range, restoring 260~~0.04~~ Health to them.

basic.name: Lightning Shield
basic.description: Imbue an ally with lightning dealing 64~~0.04~~ damage a second to nearby enemies. Each enemy hit restores 1 Mana to Rehgar. Lasts 5 seconds.

basic.name: Earthbind Totem
basic.description: Create a totem that Slows nearby enemies by 35%. The totem has 260~~0.04~~ Health and lasts for 6 seconds.

basic.name: Totemic Projection
basic.description: Instantly move Earthbind Totem to a new location.

heroic.name: Bloodlust
heroic.description: Grant nearby allied Heroes 40% Attack Speed and 35% Movement Speed and causes them to heal for 30% of the Basic Attack damage to their primary target. Lasts for 6 seconds.

heroic.name: Ancestral Healing
heroic.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180~~0.04~~ Health.

trait.name: Purge
trait.description:
When used on an allied Hero, make them Unstoppable for 0.5 seconds. When used on an enemy Hero, Slow them by 80%, decaying over 2 seconds.

Cannot be cast on yourself.

mount.name: Ghost Wolf
mount.description: Instead of using a mount, Rehgar transforms into a Ghost Wolf with 20% increased Movement Speed. Basic Attacks in Ghost Wolf form cause him to lunge at his target and deal 60% bonus damage. Dealing damage, using Abilities, and channeling cancels Ghost Wolf form.

activable.name: Healing Totem
activable.description: Activate to place a Totem that heals allied Heroes in an area for 2% of their maximum Health every second. This Totem has 125~~0.04~~ Health and lasts for 10 seconds.

activable.name: Elemental Conduit
activable.description:
Activate to gain Lightning Shield and grant all nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 10% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds. 

For up to 5 seconds after activating, hitting an enemy Hero with this effects' Lightning Shield gives nearby allies a Shield equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds.

level1.name: Stormcaller
level1.description:
Increase the radius of Lightning Shield by 25%. 

Quest: Each time Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, permanently increase Rehgar's Health by 2 and Mana by 1, stacking up to 200 times.

level1.name: Colossal Totem
level1.description:
Reactivate Earthbind Totem to move an existing totem to a new location. This can be used once per cast.

Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's area and duration by 50%, and Health by 25%.

level1.name: Feral Heart
level1.description: Ghost Wolf's Movement Speed bonus is increased to 40% for the first second, then falls to 30%. Entering or exiting Ghost Wolf form grants 15 Armor for 1 second.

level4.name: Earthliving Enchant
level4.description: When Chain Heal heals a Hero below 50% Health, they are healed an additional 160~~0.04~~ Health over 4 seconds.

level4.name: Electric Charge
level4.description:
The bearer of Lightning Shield Heals for 20% of the damage it deals to enemy Heroes, doubled if the bearer is Rehgar.

While Lightning Shield is damaging an enemy, its bearer gains 10% increased Movement Speed.

level4.name: Healing Totem
level4.description: Activate to place a Totem that heals allied Heroes in an area for 2% of their maximum Health every second. This Totem has 125~~0.04~~ Health and lasts for 10 seconds.

level7.name: Grounded Totem
level7.description:
Enemy Heroes in Earthbind Totem's area also have their Attack Speed Slowed by 15% and their Spell Power reduced by 15%.

Passive: Increase Earthbind Totem's cast range by 45%.

level7.name: Purification
level7.description:
If Purge removes a Slow, Stun, Root, or Silence effect from an ally, heal them for 220~~0.04~~.

Using Purge on an enemy Hero deals up to 330~~0.04~~ damage to Shields and reduces healing received by 40% for 2 seconds.

Passive: Reduce Purge's cooldown by 15 seconds.

level7.name: Blood and Thunder
level7.description: Ghost Wolf attacks reduce Basic Ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and restore 4% of Rehgar's maximum Mana.

level10.name: Ancestral Healing
level10.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180~~0.04~~ Health.

level10.name: Bloodlust
level10.description: Grant nearby allied Heroes 40% Attack Speed and 35% Movement Speed and causes them to heal for 30% of the Basic Attack damage to their primary target. Lasts for 6 seconds.

level13.name: Tidal Waves
level13.description: Reduces Chain Heal's cooldown by 1 second for each Hero healed, and reduces its Mana cost from 60 to 40.

level13.name: Earth Shield
level13.description: Lightning Shield gives Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 14% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.

level13.name: Wellspring
level13.description: Every 2 seconds, Earthbind Totem will cast an untalented Chain Heal at the nearest allied Hero with the lowest Health. This Chain Heal heals for 35% of its normal amount.

level16.name: Rising Storm
level16.description:
Every time a Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, increase its damage by 10%. Stacks up to 15 times.

Passive: Increase the duration of Lightning Shield by 3 seconds.

level16.name: Earthgrasp Totem
level16.description: When Earthbind Totem is first cast, it deals 90~~0.04~~ damage and Slows nearby enemies by 90% for 1 second.

level16.name: Hunger of the Wolf
level16.description: Ghost Wolf attacks against Heroes deal an additional 6% of the target's maximum Health and heal Rehgar for 6% of his maximum Health.

level20.name: Farseer's Blessing
level20.description: After 1.5 seconds, Ancestral Healing is cast a second time on the same target. Allies near the target are healed for 590~~0.04~~.

level20.name: Gladiator's War Shout
level20.description: Increase the duration and range of Bloodlust by 100%.

level20.name: Elemental Conduit
level20.description:
Activate to gain Lightning Shield and grant all nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 10% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds. 

For up to 5 seconds after activating, hitting an enemy Hero with this effects' Lightning Shield gives nearby allies a Shield equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds.

level20.name: Pit Fighter
level20.description:
Gain 10% increased Attack Damage and 3 Spell Power. Each nearby ally Hero grants an additional stack of this effect, up to 5 stacks. 

While at 2 or more stacks, Purge's cooldown refreshes 50% faster.
